arguments.note: 10 Oct: tenant emailed that the tap is getting worse and now drips constantly even when fully closed. No new ticket (duplicate). Visit remains 15 Oct 08:00-12:00 with Swift Plumbing & Heating. Contractor to be aware of worsening; tenant told to turn off isolation valve under the sink if it worsens.

arguments.body: Hello Amelia, thanks for letting us know. Your tap is already booked in under job R-4801: Swift Plumbing & Heating are due to visit on Thursday 15 October, 08:00-12:00. We haven't opened a second job, but I've added a note that it's getting worse and now drips constantly when closed. In the meantime, a small bowl or cloth under it will help, and if there's a valve on the pipe under the sink you can turn it off to stop the drip. If water starts to leak or spray, turn that valve off and reply or call us straight away. Kind regards, Mare & Co
